positive: s4watr:WaterTemperature - Water and nutrient solution temperature in reservoir
explanation: Hydroponic telemetry measures liquid solution temperature, not ambient air temperature.

positive: s4watr:TotalDissolvedSolids - Total dissolved solids concentration in nutrient water
hard_negative: s4watr:Turbidity - Cloudiness and suspended particulate matter in liquid
explanation: TDS measures dissolved mineral ions in ppm, whereas turbidity measures optical clarity (NTU).

positive: s4watr:HydrogenIonConcentration - Acidity or basicity level of nutrient reservoir
hard_negative: s4watr:Conductivity - Electrical conductivity of ionic solution
explanation: pH probe monitors logarithmic hydrogen ion activity, distinct from bulk electrical conductivity.

positive: s4watr:Conductivity - Electrical conductivity representing dissolved salt nutrients in mS/cm
hard_negative: s4watr:TotalDissolvedSolids - Mass estimate of dissolved solids in parts per million
explanation: EC directly quantifies electrical conductance in mS/cm before conversion to TDS.

positive: s4watr:FlowRate - Rate of liquid nutrient volume passing per unit time
hard_negative: s4watr:WaterLevel - Static vertical height of liquid in tank
explanation: Flow rate denotes volumetric fluid velocity, whereas water level is linear depth.

positive: s4envi:ParticulateMatter - Fine respirable atmospheric particulate matter <= 2.5 microns
hard_negative: s4envi:CO2Concentration - Carbon dioxide gas molecule concentration
explanation: PM2.5 represents physical aerosol dust particles, not gaseous carbon compounds.

positive: s4envi:CO2Concentration - Ambient carbon dioxide concentration measured in parts per million
hard_negative: s4envi:VOCConcentration - Volatile organic compound total concentration
explanation: CO2 is an inorganic greenhouse gas, whereas VOC encompasses volatile carbon chains (toluene, benzene).

positive: s4envi:VOCConcentration - Total volatile organic chemical gaseous pollutants
hard_negative: s4envi:AirQualityIndex - Composite numerical index rating overall atmospheric safety
explanation: VOC index measures specific gaseous hydrocarbon chemicals rather than a consolidated multidimensional AQI.

positive: saref:Temperature - Ambient air environmental dry-bulb temperature
hard_negative: s4watr:WaterTemperature - Fluid and water body thermal measurement
explanation: In atmospheric stations, ambient temperature monitors the surrounding gas matrix.

positive: saref:Humidity - Atmospheric relative humidity percentage in air
hard_negative: s4agri:SoilMoisture - Volumetric soil water content percentage in subterranean substrate
explanation: Air humidity refers to airborne vapor saturation, distinct from soil matric water content.

positive: s4watr:Turbidity - Optical nephelometric turbidity units indicating suspended particles in water
hard_negative: s4watr:TotalDissolvedSolids - Soluble inorganic salts dissolved completely in solution
explanation: Turbidity assesses light scattering by undissolved solids, whereas TDS measures dissolved chemical ions.

positive: s4watr:DissolvedOxygen - Concentration of gaseous oxygen molecules dissolved in water
hard_negative: s4watr:HydrogenIonConcentration - Negative logarithm of hydrogen ion activity (pH)
explanation: Dissolved oxygen quantifies aqueous O2 support for aquatic respiration, not electrochemical pH.

positive: s4watr:WaterLevel - Height or depth of water column in storage tank or reservoir
hard_negative: s4watr:WaterPressure - Force exerted per unit area by pressurized water
explanation: Water level denotes geometric surface distance, distinct from dynamic pipeline hydrostatic pressure.

positive: s4watr:WaterPressure - Static and dynamic fluid pressure inside distribution pipeline
hard_negative: s4watr:FlowRate - Volumetric discharge speed through pipe section
explanation: Water pressure measures mechanical pipe wall stress, distinct from velocity of fluid discharge.

positive: s4agri:SoilMoisture - Volumetric soil moisture content in rhizosphere
explanation: Soil moisture measures root substrate water content, whereas humidity is airborne moisture.

positive: s4agri:SoilTemperature - Thermal reading inside root soil bed
hard_negative: saref:Temperature - Ambient atmospheric canopy air temperature
explanation: Subterranean root temperature lags and differs significantly from canopy ambient air temperature.

positive: s4envi:LightIntensity - Photosynthetic illuminance and solar radiation lux
explanation: Light intensity quantifies luminous flux on plant leaves, distinct from ambient thermal heat.

positive: s4agri:Precipitation - Rainfall accumulation depth per time interval
hard_negative: s4watr:WaterLevel - Continuous surface level of standing water body
explanation: Precipitation measures incremental meteorological rainfall accumulation, not reservoir level.
